newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Gas blast kills two in Kazakh capital.
newsitem.headline: Gas blast kills two in Kazakh capital.

text.p: Two people were killed and five were injured on Sunday night in a gas explosion that ripped through an apartment block in the centre of Kazakhstan's capital Almaty, officials said on Monday.
A spokesman for the country's State Committee for Emergency Situations told Reuters the powerful blast destroyed 15 flats in the five-storey block and wrecked three cars parked nearby.
"We do not know yet whether the blast was caused by a gas leak or use of home-made gas appliances. A special commission is currently investigating the case," said the spokesman.
